name: NBCC (India) Limited
summary: NBCC (India) Limited engages in project management consultancy, engineering procurement and construction, and real estate development businesses in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: PMC; EPC; and Real Estate. It offers services for various civil construction projects, including residential and commercial complexes, re-development of old government colonies, education and medical institutions, infrastructure project roads, water supply systems, storm water systems, and water storage solutions. The company executes various projects, which include high-rise chimneys, cooling towers, coal handling plants, etc.; project conceptualization, feasibility studies,…
